label: About
title: About One Stitch Out of Line
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 5 recent saved-signal files and 7 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @alliharvard: try music you might like it. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became One Stitch Out of Line: Landscape embroidery: a large smiling green long-necked creature with cream-spotted taupe shell faces a smaller blue grand piano across broad coral-orange weave. Sparse cream notes bridge the gap; raised lid, pale keys and slender legs remain distinct. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Raised green head and curved neck embroidery, Cream-outlined brown shell with cream stitched spots, and Exposed orange woven ground.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
